# OPCG 卡牌助手 (optcgassistant.com)

Unofficial ONE PIECE CARD GAME (OPCG / OPTCG) fan toolkit. Not affiliated with BANDAI.

## Primary pages
- https://optcgassistant.com/ — hub
- https://optcgassistant.com/search — card database
- https://optcgassistant.com/sets — set lists (OP / EB / ST / P)
- https://optcgassistant.com/builder — deck builder
- https://optcgassistant.com/play — browser battles (rooms + AI)
- https://optcgassistant.com/tournaments — tournament deck lists
- https://optcgassistant.com/prices — market prices (Yuyu-tei, JPY)
- https://optcgassistant.com/cards/{id} — individual card (e.g. /cards/OP01-001)

## Languages
Traditional Chinese (default), Simplified Chinese, English.
